links.outcome: LLM diagnostic agreement versus glaucoma specialists on same data against consensus reference standards
links.effect: Specialist accuracy 71.3%-83.9% (κ 0.46-0.68); GPT-5 Pro long prompt 80.4%-85.7% (κ 0.61-0.71); Gemini 3 Pro long prompt 80.9%-84.3% (κ 0.62-0.68); Grok 2.2 near chance.
links.quote: Glaucoma specialist accuracy ranged from 71.3% to 83.9% (κ = 0.46-0.68).

screen.reason: This study evaluates the diagnostic classification accuracy and inter-expert agreement of several multimodal foundation LLMs on retrospective clinical and imaging data without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
